embeds.title: 🟡 Turla Transforms Kazuar Backdoor Into Modular P2P Botnet
embeds.description:
**Actor:** Turla
Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that the Russian state-sponsored hacking group Turla (also known as Secret Blizzard) has evolved its Kazuar backdoor into a modular peer-to-peer botnet with three component types (Kernel, Bridge, Worker) designed for stealth and persistent access. The malware uses droppers like Pelmeni and ShadowLoader for deployment and communicates via Exchange Web Services, HTTP, and WebSockets. CISA assesses Turla as affiliated with Russia's FSB Center 16.

**CVEs:** none • **Access:** n/a
